# CertiVault dummy certificate dataset

A realistic, reproducible **dummy** dataset: **100 fictional people** holding
**191 certificates** from **5 fictional institutions**, generated by
[`scripts/generate_dataset.php`](../../../scripts/generate_dataset.php).

Every certificate was issued through the application's **real** issuance
pipeline (`IssuanceService` + `CertificatePdfService`): a signed A4 PDF with
an embedded verification QR code, the canonical SHA-256 digest, an RSA-2048
signature by the institution's own key, and that key's fingerprint pinned
outside the database. Each certificate therefore verifies cryptographically,
just like one an institution issues by hand. After generation, every
certificate was checked again with `VerificationService` (191/191 gave the
expected verdict).

> All people, institutions and e-mail addresses are invented. Every account
> uses the reserved domain `@dataset.example.com` (RFC 2606), so no real
> mailbox can receive mail from these accounts.

## What is in it

| | |
|---|---|
| Institutions | 5. Each one is approved, has an RSA key (key v1, active) and has that key pinned. |
| People | 100 activated student accounts (85 graduated, 15 still enrolled). The names mix Indian and international names. |
| Certificates | 191: 77 degrees, 14 diplomas, 47 certifications, 22 MOOCs, 25 workshops, 6 internships. Issue dates run from 2019 to 2026. |
| Verdicts (as of 2026-11-18) | 168 **VALID** · 10 **EXPIRED** · 7 **REVOKED** · 6 **SUPERSEDED** (each SUPERSEDED one has a corrected v2 that is VALID) |

| Code | Institution | Certificates |
|---|---|---|
| NBIT | Northbridge Institute of Technology | 51 |
| WSD | Westlake School of Design | 32 |
| RCCM | Riverside College of Commerce and Management | 34 |
| LIHS | Lakeview Institute of Health Sciences | 37 |
| OSOA | Open Skills Online Academy (online short courses only) | 37 |

How the states come about:

- **Expired**: courses with a validity period get an expiry date. For example, BLS/ACLS certification is valid for 2 years and Cloud / Project Management for 3 years. Some of those dates have already passed.
- **Revoked**: about 4% of certificates. They are revoked with the same database changes as `revoke_certificate.php`: a written reason, `revoked_at`, `revoked_by` set to the institution admin, and a transparency-log event.
- **Superseded**: about 3% of certificates. The original (v1) has a typo in its title. A corrected v2 (ID suffix `-V2`) is issued and linked to it with the same database changes as `supersede_certificate.php`.
- **Certificate IDs**: these use the app's custom-ID feature, in the format `<INST>/<YEAR>/<COURSE>/<NNNN>`, for example `NBIT/2023/BTCSE/0004`. Verify accepts any spacing or case variant, such as `nbit 2023 btcse 0004`.

## Logging in (demo credentials)

All dataset accounts use the password **`Demo@12345`**. These are local
demo accounts only; never reuse this password anywhere real.

| Role | Login |
|---|---|
| Institution admin | `registrar.northbridge@dataset.example.com`, `registrar.westlake@…`, `registrar.riverside@…`, `registrar.lakeview@…`, `credentials.openskills@…` (see `institutions.csv`) |
| Student | Any e-mail in `people.csv`, for example `lea.moreau@dataset.example.com` (Léa Moreau) or `neha.verma@dataset.example.com` (Neha Verma) |

## Files

| File | Rows | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `certificates_dataset.csv` | 191 | One row per certificate. Columns: `certificate_id, version, previous_certificate_id, holder_name, holder_email, enrollment_number, institution, title, credential_type, issue_date, expiry_date, status, expected_verdict, verdict_as_of, revocation_reason, verify_url, sha256, file_sha256` |
| `people.csv` | 100 | One row per person. Columns: `person_id, full_name, email, enrollment_number, home_institution, programme, programme_status, certificate_count, certificate_ids` |
| `institutions.csv` | 5 | `code, institution, admin_email, certificates, active_key_id, public_key_fingerprint_sha256` |
| `bulk_issue_100.csv` | 100 | One new certificate per person, in the **exact** format that *Bulk issue from CSV* (`bulk_issue.php`) accepts: `student_email, student_name, title, issue_date, expiry_date, certificate_id`. `certificate_id` is left blank, so the app assigns `CV-YYYY-NNNNNN` IDs and the file can be uploaded more than once. |

Column notes:

- `status` is the effective status the app displays. An active certificate whose expiry date has passed shows as `expired`.
- `expected_verdict` is what `verify.php` returns on the `verdict_as_of` date. Certificates with an expiry date move from VALID to EXPIRED as time passes.
- `verify_url` is relative. Prefix it with the app's base URL, for example `http://localhost:8081/verify.php?token=…`. The QR code inside each PDF already contains the full URL that was in use at generation time (`CV_BASE_URL`, or `http://localhost:8081` for CLI runs).
- `sha256` is the canonical digest that was signed. `file_sha256` is the hash of the stored PDF.
- The CSVs are UTF-8 with a BOM, so spreadsheet apps show accented names correctly.

The **tokens, hashes, PDFs and key fingerprints belong to the database this
was generated into**. The QR tokens and keys are random, so a regeneration
gives new ones. Names, e-mails, courses, dates and certificate IDs do not
change for the same `--seed` and `--people`. No private keys, password
hashes or other secrets are written to these files. The PDFs and QR images
are stored in `private_data/uploads/` and `public/qrcodes/`, which are both
git-ignored. Key pins are kept in `private_data/pins/`, which is also
git-ignored.

## Try it

1. Generate the dataset (see below), then start the app with `php -S localhost:8081 -t public`.
2. Open the verify page and enter one certificate of each kind:
   - **VALID**: `WSD/2019/BDPD/0001`, or a corrected version such as `RCCM/2021/MBAF/0007-V2`.
   - **EXPIRED**: `LIHS/2019/ACLS/0001` or `LIHS/2023/BLS/0003`.
   - **REVOKED**: `OSOA/2021/CPE/0001` or `WSD/2024/BDCD/0004`. The issuing institution sees the reason on its certificate page.
   - **SUPERSEDED**: `RCCM/2021/MBAF/0007` or `NBIT/2022/BTECE/0003`. The page links to the corrected version.
3. Log in as `registrar.northbridge@dataset.example.com` to see 51 issued certificates. From there you can revoke or supersede certificates, view analytics and audit logs, or upload `bulk_issue_100.csv` under *Bulk issue*.
4. Log in as a student to see that person's certificates, download them, or create share links.
5. Download a PDF and drop it into Smart Verify (exact-file match), or scan its QR code.

## Regenerate / reset

```bash
php scripts/generate_dataset.php --dry-run          # plan + pre-flight checks, writes nothing
php scripts/generate_dataset.php                    # generate (100 people, seed 2026) + re-verify all
php scripts/generate_dataset.php --reset            # remove ONLY the dataset (rows + PDFs + QR images)
php scripts/generate_dataset.php --people=40 --seed=7   # a different, smaller dataset
php scripts/generate_dataset.php --csv-only --out=/tmp/ds  # just the CSVs from the plan (no DB)
```

Other options: `--db=NAME` selects the target database (for example
`certivault_test`). `--base-url=URL` sets the URL baked into the QR codes;
use it when the app is not served at `http://localhost:8081`.

- **Running twice is safe.** If a dataset already exists, the script refuses (exit code 2) and changes nothing.
- **`--reset` only touches dataset accounts.** It removes accounts on `@dataset.example.com`, never a super admin. It also removes the five institutions they own (only when the name matches), every certificate those institutions issued or those people hold, those certificates' verification-log rows, and their PDF and QR files. This includes certificates issued later through the UI, for example from `bulk_issue_100.csv`.
- **Some records are deliberately kept.** Transparency-log entries and key pins are append-only by design.
- **Partial runs are cleaned up.** If generation fails partway, the partial dataset is removed automatically.
- **Generation takes about a minute** for 100 people, mostly PDF rendering.
